body: As I stand beside the child, I notice the depth of their distress, the shaking of their shoulders and the quivering of their lips. My heart goes out to them, and I think about the countless times I've seen such tears, the mix of fear and vulnerability that they display. I feel a strong urge to shield them from the world and provide a sense of comfort and safety. I gently place a hand on their small shoulder, trying to reassure them that everything will be alright.
